enum.name: ActionKind
enum.comment: Character action category shared by the authoritative server and predicted client.

var.name: NONE
var.comment: No action; reserved as the enum default.

var.name: NORMAL_ATTACK
var.comment: A normal combo attack selected from ActionSet.normal_attack_ids.

var.name: MOVING_ATTACK
var.comment: A moving combo attack selected from ActionSet.moving_attack_ids.

var.name: SKILL
var.comment: The character's regular active skill.

var.name: SPECIAL_ATTACK
var.comment: The held-input special attack.

var.name: ULTIMATE
var.comment: The energy-consuming ultimate action.

bean.name: BattleRule
bean.comment: Shared fixed-tick battle rules used by prediction, authority, combo timing, and reconciliation.

var.name: id
var.comment: Stable primary key referenced by Character.battle_rule_id.

var.name: name
var.comment: Human-readable rule-set name for diagnostics and authoring.

var.name: tick_rate
var.comment: Authoritative simulation ticks per second; the client must use the same value.

var.name: reconciliation_distance_milli_units
var.comment: Prediction correction threshold in one-thousandth world units.

var.name: combo_reset_ticks
var.comment: Idle ticks after which the normal-attack combo index resets.

var.name: special_hold_ticks
var.comment: Continuous attack-input ticks required to select the special attack.

var.name: attack_buffer_ticks
var.comment: Ticks for which one released light-attack intent remains buffered while the character cannot act.

var.name: land_recovery_ticks
var.comment: Positive grounded recovery ticks synthesized into the runtime Land action by the Luban adapter.

var.name: input_timeout_ticks
var.comment: Maximum ticks for which the server may reuse the last input before forcing neutral input.

var.name: prediction_history_ticks
var.comment: Maximum predicted snapshots retained for reconciliation and replay.

bean.name: CharacterProperty
bean.comment: Shared immutable combat attributes for a character archetype.

var.name: id
var.comment: Stable primary key referenced by Character.property_id.

var.name: name
var.comment: Human-readable property-profile name.

var.name: attack
var.comment: Base attack used by damage formulas.

var.name: attack_speed_permille
var.comment: Attack-speed multiplier where 1000 equals 1.0.

var.name: critical_damage_permille
var.comment: Critical bonus damage where 1000 adds another 100 percent of the pre-critical damage.

var.name: critical_rate_permille
var.comment: Critical-hit probability where 1000 equals 100 percent.

var.name: defense
var.comment: Base defense used by damage formulas.

var.name: max_hp
var.comment: Maximum hit points at spawn.

var.name: core_energy_limit
var.comment: Maximum core or special energy.

var.name: ultimate_energy_limit
var.comment: Maximum ultimate energy.

bean.name: Locomotion
bean.comment: Shared walk, run, sprint, jump, gravity, and air-control parameters.

var.name: id
var.comment: Stable primary key referenced by Character.locomotion_id.

var.name: name
var.comment: Human-readable locomotion-profile name.

var.name: walk_speed_milli_units_per_second
var.comment: Walking speed in one-thousandth world units per second.

var.name: run_speed_milli_units_per_second
var.comment: Running speed in one-thousandth world units per second.

var.name: sprint_speed_milli_units_per_second
var.comment: Sprinting speed in one-thousandth world units per second.

var.name: air_move_speed_milli_units_per_second
var.comment: Maximum horizontal air-control speed in one-thousandth world units per second.

var.name: jump_speed_milli_units_per_second
var.comment: Initial upward jump speed in one-thousandth world units per second.

var.name: gravity_milli_units_per_second_squared
var.comment: Downward acceleration in one-thousandth world units per second squared.

bean.name: Dodge
bean.comment: Shared deterministic dodge movement, cooldown, and invulnerability window.

var.name: id
var.comment: Stable primary key referenced by Character.dodge_id.

var.name: name
var.comment: Human-readable dodge-profile name.

var.name: forward_speed_milli_units_per_second
var.comment: Forward dodge speed in one-thousandth world units per second.

var.name: backward_speed_milli_units_per_second
var.comment: Backward dodge speed in one-thousandth world units per second.

var.name: duration_ticks
var.comment: Total dodge duration in simulation ticks.

var.name: cooldown_ticks
var.comment: Ticks between accepted dodge starts.

var.name: invulnerable_start_tick
var.comment: First dodge-local tick that grants invulnerability.

var.name: invulnerable_end_tick
var.comment: Last dodge-local tick that grants invulnerability.

bean.name: Action
bean.comment: Shared attack or skill phases, movement, hit rules, resource changes, and a client-only animation sequence binding.

var.name: id
var.comment: Stable action primary key referenced by ActionSet lists and fields.

var.name: name
var.comment: Human-readable action name used in diagnostics.

var.name: kind
var.comment: Gameplay branch that executes this action.

var.name: windup_ticks
var.comment: Authoritative startup ticks before the active hit phase.

var.name: active_ticks
var.comment: Authoritative active ticks in which hit detection may resolve.

var.name: recovery_ticks
var.comment: Authoritative recovery ticks after the active phase.

var.name: cooldown_ticks
var.comment: Additional cooldown ticks before this action can start again.

var.name: invincible_start_tick
var.comment: Inclusive invulnerability start tick, or -1 when the action has no invulnerability window.

var.name: invincible_end_tick
var.comment: Inclusive invulnerability end tick, or -1 when the action has no invulnerability window.

var.name: motion_start_tick
var.comment: Start tick of the half-open authoritative displacement interval.

var.name: motion_end_tick
var.comment: End tick of the half-open authoritative displacement interval.

var.name: forward_displacement_milli_units
var.comment: Total forward displacement over the motion interval in one-thousandth world units.

var.name: damage_permille
var.comment: Attack multiplier where 1000 equals base attack.

var.name: hit_range_milli_units
var.comment: Authoritative target query range in one-thousandth world units.

var.name: core_energy_cost
var.comment: Core energy consumed when the action is accepted.

var.name: ultimate_energy_cost
var.comment: Ultimate energy consumed when the action is accepted.

var.name: core_energy_gain_on_confirmed_hit
var.comment: Core energy granted only after the authoritative hit is confirmed.

var.name: ultimate_energy_gain_on_confirmed_hit
var.comment: Ultimate energy granted only after the authoritative hit is confirmed.

var.name: animation_clip_ids
var.comment: Ordered client-only Spine clip references; skill startup and skill body can use two entries.

table.name: TbAction
table.comment: Normal attacks, moving attacks, skill, held special, and ultimate actions.

bean.name: ActionSet
bean.comment: Shared action composition for one character archetype.

var.name: id
var.comment: Stable primary key referenced by Character.action_set_id.

var.name: name
var.comment: Human-readable action-set name.

var.name: normal_attack_ids
var.comment: Ordered normal-attack combo action references.

var.name: moving_attack_ids
var.comment: Ordered moving-attack combo action references.

var.name: skill_action_id
var.comment: Regular skill action reference.

var.name: special_action_id
var.comment: Held-input special action reference.

var.name: ultimate_action_id
var.comment: Ultimate action reference.

bean.name: Character
bean.comment: Character archetype composed entirely through validated table references.

var.name: id
var.comment: Stable character archetype ID selected by session or gameplay code.

var.name: name
var.comment: Human-readable character name.

var.name: battle_rule_id
var.comment: Applicable fixed-tick battle-rule reference.

var.name: property_id
var.comment: Combat property-profile reference.

var.name: locomotion_id
var.comment: Locomotion-profile reference.

var.name: dodge_id
var.comment: Dodge-profile reference.

var.name: action_set_id
var.comment: Combo and skill action-set reference.

var.name: presentation_id
var.comment: Client-only visual presentation reference.

table.name: TbCharacter
table.comment: Composable character archetypes without a root configuration object.

bean.name: AnimationClip
bean.comment: Client-only Spine animation clip binding and playback metadata.

var.name: id
var.comment: Stable animation binding ID referenced by Action and CharacterPresentation.

var.name: name
var.comment: Human-readable animation binding name.

var.name: spine_animation_name
var.comment: Exact animation name stored in the Spine SkeletonData asset.

var.name: loop
var.comment: Whether the Spine track entry loops.

var.name: track_index
var.comment: Spine track index; full-body character clips normally use track zero.

var.name: mix_duration_milliseconds
var.comment: Cross-fade duration in milliseconds.

var.name: playback_speed_permille
var.comment: Playback speed where 1000 equals normal speed.

bean.name: CharacterPresentation
bean.comment: Client-only prefab and locomotion-state animation bindings for a character.

var.name: id
var.comment: Stable presentation primary key referenced by Character.presentation_id.

var.name: name
var.comment: Human-readable presentation-profile name.

var.name: prefab_asset_path
var.comment: Unity project asset path or address used to instantiate the visual prefab.

var.name: idle_clip_id
var.comment: Idle animation reference.

var.name: walk_clip_id
var.comment: Walk animation reference.

var.name: run_clip_id
var.comment: Run animation reference.

var.name: sprint_clip_id
var.comment: Sprint animation reference.

var.name: jump_clip_id
var.comment: Jump startup animation reference.

var.name: rise_clip_id
var.comment: Ascending airborne animation reference.

var.name: fall_clip_id
var.comment: Descending airborne animation reference.

var.name: land_clip_id
var.comment: Landing animation reference.

var.name: forward_dodge_clip_id
var.comment: Forward dodge animation reference.

var.name: backward_dodge_clip_id
var.comment: Backward dodge animation reference.

var.name: attacked_clip_id
var.comment: Hit-reaction animation reference.

var.name: death_clip_id
var.comment: Death animation reference.

table.name: TbCharacterPresentation
table.comment: Client-only visual prefab and locomotion animation profile.
